mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary policy cycle, reducing discount rates applied to equity valuations and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained drop in the unemployment rate below 6.0% triggers increased labor market confidence, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns do not exceed baseline by 1% in 60% of instances where UNRATE falls below 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in GDP growth (GDPC1) and housing market activity (HOUST) indicate robust demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The interaction between GDPC1 and HOUST is not statistically significant (p > 0.05) in a 5-day window.

mechanism_narrative: During a late-cycle expansion phase, rising CPIAUCSL (inflation) and GDPC1 (GDP) suggest sustained economic momentum, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In late-cycle expansion periods, S&P 500 60-day forward returns are not positively correlated with CPIAUCSL and GDPC1 trends.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained payroll growth exceeding 135,000 new jobs (PAYEMS) reflects strong labor demand, prompting market optimism and positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: PAYEMS exceeds 135,000 in less than 30% of 5-day windows, failing to predict positive returns.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained surge in the industrial production index above 100.0 (INDPRO) signals robust supply chain activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: INDPRO above 100.0 occurs without subsequent positive 20-day S&P 500 returns in 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising federal funds rates alongside increasing CPIAUCSL (inflation) create conflicting signals, but their combined effect on equity discount rates generates positive S&P 500 forward returns within 5 trading days.
failure_condition: The joint effect of FEDFUNDS and CPIAUCSL does not produce a statistically significant positive return (p > 0.05) in 5-day windows.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle, sustained federal funds rates above 4.5% signal higher borrowing costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day forward returns remain positive despite FEDFUNDS exceeding 4.5% in 60% of tightening cycles.
